# Mataram

TypeScript library for the WhatsApp Web API. Direct WebSocket connection — no browser, no Selenium.

```
npm install @mataram/wa
```

📖 **Full documentation:** [mataramwa.vercel.app](https://mataramwa.vercel.app)

---

## Quick Start

```ts
import makeWASocket, {
  useMultiFileAuthState,
  DisconnectReason,
  Browsers,
} from '@mataram/wa'

const { state, saveCreds } = await useMultiFileAuthState('auth')

const sock = makeWASocket({
  auth: state,
  browser: Browsers.macOS('Chrome'),
})

sock.ev.on('creds.update', saveCreds)

sock.ev.on('connection.update', ({ connection, lastDisconnect }) => {
  if (connection === 'open') {
    console.log('Connected:', sock.user?.id)
  }
  if (connection === 'close') {
    const code = lastDisconnect?.error?.output?.statusCode
    if (code !== DisconnectReason.loggedOut) {
      setTimeout(() => process.exit(), 3000)
    }
  }
})

if (!state.creds.registered) {
  const code = await sock.requestPairingCode('6281234567890')
  console.log('Pairing code:', code)
}
```

> Use `Browsers.macOS('Chrome')`, `Browsers.windows('Edge')`, or `Browsers.ubuntu('Firefox')`. Custom browser names are rejected by WhatsApp.

## Send Messages

```ts
// Text
await sock.sendMessage('628xxx@s.whatsapp.net', { text: 'Hello' })

// Image
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { image: { url: './photo.jpg' }, caption: 'Caption' })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { image: fs.readFileSync('./photo.jpg') })

// Video / Audio / Document
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { video: { url: './video.mp4' }, caption: 'Video' })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { audio: { url: './audio.ogg' }, mimetype: 'audio/ogg; codecs=opus', ptt: true })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { document: { url: './file.pdf' }, fileName: 'file.pdf' })

// Reply / Reaction / Mention
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { text: 'Reply' }, { quoted: originalMessage })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { react: { text: '\u2764', key: messageKey } })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { text: 'Hello @628xxx', mentions: ['628xxx@s.whatsapp.net'] })

// Edit / Delete
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { text: 'Edited text', edit: messageKey })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { delete: messageKey })

// Poll
await sock.sendMessage(jid, {
  poll: { name: 'Question?', values: ['A', 'B', 'C'], selectableCount: 1 },
})

// Location / Contact
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { location: { degreesLatitude: -6.2, degreesLongitude: 106.8 } })
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { contacts: { displayName: 'Name', contacts: [{ vcard }] } })

// View Once
await sock.sendMessage(jid, { image: { url: './photo.jpg' }, viewOnce: true })
```

## Events

```ts
sock.ev.on('messages.upsert', ({ messages, type }) => {
  for (const msg of messages) {
    const text = msg.message?.conversation || msg.message?.extendedTextMessage?.text
    console.log(`[${msg.key.remoteJid}] ${text}`)
  }
})

sock.ev.on('connection.update', ({ connection, lastDisconnect, qr }) => {})
sock.ev.on('group-participants.update', ({ id, participants, action }) => {})
sock.ev.on('presence.update', ({ id, presences }) => {})
sock.ev.on('call', (calls) => {})
sock.ev.on('messages.update', (updates) => {})
sock.ev.on('messages.reaction', ({ key, reaction }) => {})
sock.ev.on('creds.update', (update) => {})
sock.ev.on('chats.upsert', (chats) => {})
sock.ev.on('contacts.upsert', (contacts) => {})
sock.ev.on('groups.upsert', (groups) => {})
sock.ev.on('groups.update', (updates) => {})
sock.ev.on('messaging-history.set', ({ chats, messages }) => {})
```

## Groups & Communities

```ts
// Groups
const group = await sock.groupCreate('Group Name', ['628xxx@s.whatsapp.net'])
await sock.groupParticipantsUpdate('123@g.us', ['628xxx'], 'add') // remove, promote, demote
await sock.groupUpdateSubject('123@g.us', 'New Name')
await sock.groupUpdateDescription('123@g.us', 'New description')
await sock.groupSettingUpdate('123@g.us', 'announcement') // or not_announcement
await sock.groupToggleEphemeral('123@g.us', 86400) // 0, 86400, 604800, 7776000
const code = await sock.groupInviteCode('123@g.us')
const info = await sock.groupMetadata('123@g.us')

// Communities
const comm = await sock.communityCreate('Community Name', 'Description')
await sock.communityCreateGroup('Group Name', ['628xxx'], 'parent_community@g.us')
await sock.communityLinkGroup('comm@g.us', 'group@g.us')
const members = await sock.communityRequestParticipantsList('comm@g.us')
await sock.communityAcceptInvite('INVITE_CODE')
```

## Chat Management

```ts
await sock.readMessages([messageKey])
await sock.chatModify({ archive: true }, jid)
await sock.chatModify({ mute: 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000 }, jid)
await sock.chatModify({ pin: true }, jid)
await sock.chatModify({ delete: true }, jid)
await sock.sendPresenceUpdate('composing', jid)
```

## Profile & Privacy

```ts
await sock.updateProfilePicture(jid, { url: './photo.jpg' })
await sock.updateBlockStatus(jid, 'block')
```

## Business & Labels

```ts
const profile = await sock.getBusinessProfile('628xxx@s.whatsapp.net')
```

## Configuration

```ts
const sock = makeWASocket({
  auth,                                   // Required: authentication state
  browser: Browsers.macOS('Chrome'),       // Browser identity
  version: [2, 3000, 1035194821],          // WA Web version
  connectTimeoutMs: 20000,                 // Connection timeout
  keepAliveIntervalMs: 30000,              // Ping interval
  markOnlineOnConnect: true,               // Show online on connect
  syncFullHistory: true,                   // Sync chat history
  fireInitQueries: true,                   // Auto-init queries
  emitOwnEvents: true,                     // Events for own actions
  logger: pino({ level: 'silent' }),       // Logger instance
  agent: socksProxyAgent,                  // WebSocket proxy
  generateHighQualityLinkPreview: false,   // Link preview
  msgRetryCounterCache: cache,             // Retry counter cache
  getMessage: async (key) => store.get(key), // Message lookup
  cachedGroupMetadata: async (jid) => cache.get(jid), // Group cache
})
```

---

## Error Codes

| Code | Constant | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `DisconnectReason.loggedOut` | Session expired |
| 403 | `DisconnectReason.forbidden` | Account restricted |
| 408 | `DisconnectReason.timedOut` | Timeout |
| 428 | `DisconnectReason.connectionClosed` | Connection closed |
| 500 | `DisconnectReason.badSession` | Corrupted session |
| 515 | `DisconnectReason.restartRequired` | Normal restart after pairing |
